craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at contemplating-going — exultation register: trust-and-freedom song. Gross-going-five; earth-first kept. Rejected: (a) five→fivefold-word → killed: go-five verbs it. Read aloud: KNOWN-flash-ing HERE in-WILL … MAY-go-FIVE.

lines: Known-flashing here in will, in lordship — one-sided abiding —
by grossness earth-first elements may go five.
